paragraphs.text: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System
# dsh-superagent
> **Research prototype for reference only, not an official DeepSeek product.** This code grew out of
our team's day-to-day development work, with much of the engineering done by coding agents. Treat i
t as research code, not production-ready software. It may still contain bugs, and its coding style a
nd engineering practices may be inconsistent. Review and adapt it before using it in your own enviro

nment.
>
> We have adapted it for publication, so it is not identical to our internal version or the
implementation described in *Exploring Super-agent Design: Towards a More Autonomous Agent System*.
Some designs discussed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented
ssed in the article are directions for future development and are not implemented in this prototype.
dsh-superagent is a proactive coding agent for one GitHub repository, packaged as a bundle for DeepS
eek Harness. It listens to GitHub and, optionally, Feishu. When someone allowed asks the agent for w
ork, it opens a work item, works on it in its own agent session and directory, and answers in the or
iginal conversation, for example with a pull request. A web panel shows what needs a person.
It is also a way of working with an agent: **take as little human attention as possible, and give as
much value as possible.** An agent that can act for a whole team can also waste a whole team's atte
ntion, so it acts only when asked or when a rule the team wrote allows it, and speaks only when some
one must act or can use a result. docs/000-philosophy.md explains the principle and what it asks of
or can use a result. docs/000-philosophy.md explains the principle and what it asks of the operator.
## Setup
Setup has many steps, so an agent does it with you. Ask your coding agent:
> Read SETUP.md in this repository and set up dsh-superagent with me.
It asks one short question at a time, shows the full plan once, and then installs and configures eve
rything. SETUP.md is what it follows.
## Documentation
